identity.name: Fitcheck
identity.tagline: Turn every shopper into your fit model
identity.mission: Fitcheck is a done-for-you AI virtual try-on launch service for Shopify fashion brands.

positioning.differentiation: Done-for-you AI virtual try-on launch service: Personalized demo renders used as outbound hook; Pilot widget on selected best-selling SKUs; 48-hour launch promise from approval to live; Shopify-first workflow, not API/manual export; Revenue/ROI framing instead of AI novelty framing

persona.who: Founder / CEO of Shopify Fashion Brand (10-50 employees)
pains: Returns are killing margin due to fit uncertainty
Customers hesitate because photos don't show their body type
Need something easy to test, not a six-month project
Lost product-page conversions and add-to-cart opportunities
gains: Launch a 'wow' buying moment without a months-long technical project
Differentiate from competitors with richer shopping experience
